test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:**

It is believed that the minister will announce the new reforms next week.

options.text: People think the reforms have already been announced.
People believe that the minister will announce the new reforms next week
The new reforms are announced by the minister.
It was believed that the reforms would be announced.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The subject of the active voice sentence becomes the object in the passive voice sentence.
 
• Active voice version of the sentence: "People believe that the minister will announce the new reforms next week."
 
• To convert from passive to active, identify the agent performing the action ("People") and make it the subject of the sentence.
 
• Keep the verb in its active form ("believe") and ensure the rest of the sentence conveys the same meaning.
 
• The timing phrase "next week" remains unchanged at the end of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"People think the reforms have already been announced." – Incorrect meaning, as the timing differs from "next week".
 
• **Option 3: **"The new reforms are announced by the minister." – Incorrect tense and structure.
 
• **Option 4: **"It was believed that the reforms would be announced." – Incorrect tense and passive voice.
